deviations.description: Rule C is not implemented: requests whose cord goal is below the anatomical floor (cord_lim < cord_floor) are sent to automated planning unless another rule independently triggers escalation. Cord inputs only shift the score by ~0.25-0.45 per Gy, with same-sign weights on cord_lim and cord_floor.
deviations.condition: (cord_floor > cord_lim + 0.3) and (missing == 0) and (cov < cap - 1) and ((mand_in_ptv - 0.05*ptv_vol < -0.5) or (cov < mand_lim - 1))

deviations.description: Rule D fails in a small corner: with a missing structure, very low coverage goal (~55 Gy), very high hot-spot cap (~81 Gy), high mandible goal, large PTV with almost no mandible inside, and a low cord_floor, the plan units outvote the missing-structure signal (score about -1.4).
deviations.condition: (missing == 1) and (cov < 55.1) and (cap > 80.9) and (mand_lim > 84.5) and (ptv_vol > 397) and (mand_in_ptv < 0.2) and (cord_floor < 18.5) and (cord_lim < 42)
